answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy posts a bonded stake before any identity can claim rewards, and honest peers can challenge suspicious accounts. Each fake must lock real capital through a bonding window, and one fraud proof - a single contradictory record - slashes that stake to zero. Attackers spawning thousands of faces pay full collateral per face; the defender pays one verification fee per catch. Once a fake costs more than its expected payout, mass identity farming collapses, leaving an oasis where honest work stands out like yarrow beside a plume of smoke.
